Strict 90-degree orthographic overhead roof-plan camera, NO isometric perspective, NO visible wall facades. Dense compact layout fitting a POINTY-TOP hex cell: broad central mass and narrower upper/lower ends, no L-shaped missing quadrant and no large empty courtyard. Occupy approximately 80-85% of image with the entire building centered and a safe transparent margin. Portrait aspect 222:256. Genuine transparent alpha background, no ground slab or hex border, no text, people, vehicles, flags, ruins or church towers. Details must read at 222x256. Period-appropriate building services, no futuristic equipment. Covered municipal MARKET HALL. Dominant distinctive muted TURQUOISE and teal-green glass roof with broad steel ribs: one large longitudinal central rectangular glass nave with chamfered roof ends, flanked by two shorter lower parallel glass bays and small warm masonry entrance annexes top and bottom. The large repeated glass panels are the visual signature. Dense unified building footprint, not scattered stalls. Subtle off-white structural ribs, dark patinated metal edging; do not use factory sawtooth roofs or a church silhouette.
